subject: Quick 25m walkthrough? — DataWave benchmark download

Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom@datawave.io>
Date: Wed, 8 Mar 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Downloaded benchmark — quick walkthrough request

Hi Jasmine & Ben,

Thanks for the benchmark report — I just finished the download (attached) and had a few targeted questions. We are evaluating inference economics across a couple of models and would like a short timeboxed walkthrough to:

- confirm what hardware profile produced the numbers in the PDF,
- understand typical latency at ~2k token contexts for multi-turn chat, and
- get recommendations on batching/cache settings for our workload.

Could we do a 25-minute walkthrough next week? Our team is in London (BST) — mornings work best for us (9:30–11:30). If possible we’d like a short technical attendee (Tom) plus product/PO (me). I attached a quick list of questions.

Attachments: benchmark_report_DataWave_20280306.pdf, datawave_questions_0308.docx

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Director of Data Platform | DataWave Analytics
priya@datawave.io
+44 20 7946 0321

Hi Priya — great to meet you over email, and glad you found the benchmark helpful. I’m Ben (SDR) — I’ll get this scheduled.

We can do a 25-minute slot; here are a few windows next week (all BST):
- Tue Mar 14 — 10:00 or 11:15
- Thu Mar 16 — 10:00 or 14:00

If one of those fits, pick it and I’ll send the calendar invite with a short agenda. Alternatively you can pick a time directly here: https://calendar.redwood.ai/confirm?token=aj3k9x

Cheers,

Ben — thanks, Thu Mar 16 at 10:00 BST works for us. Please note Tom will join for the technical bits; I’ll be on for the full 25.

A couple of quick clarifications so we come prepared:
- Our desired throughput target is ~30 reqs/s for 1.5k tokens median (burst to 60). Is that in scope to look at?
- We prefer a short pre-read, so if you could highlight the kernel/quantization variant used for the PDF numbers that’d be super helpful.

Looking forward — please send the invite.

Best,
Priya
